purpose: Verify that the assurance system itself is complete, independent, current, and constitutionally bounded.
claims: verifier is not the implementation under verification
evidence independence is explicit and common-source correlation is detected
verification oracle is versioned and itself tested
assurance controls cannot silently weaken trust anchors
stale verifier, contract, policy, oracle, or evidence cannot certify current state
unknown assurance coverage is tracked as debt and never coerced to PASS
assurance decisions are reproducible from immutable inputs
assurance failures preserve evidence before recovery
assurance certification and merge remain separate governed decisions
hard_rules: assurance cannot certify itself without an independent upstream verification boundary
shared-source evidence is not independent merely because it has multiple records
unknown coverage is a first-class failure condition
a verifier change invalidates dependent assurance evidence until reverified
an oracle change invalidates dependent verification evidence until reverified
a constitution change requires explicit governance and cannot be autonomously self-approved
recovery success is not proof of correctness
no certification from an unresolved assurance gap
